def compute_agg(state, func, arg):

    if func=="count":
        if arg=="*":
            return state.count_star
        else:
            return state.counts.get(arg,0)
    elif func=="count_distinct":
        return len(state.distincts.get(arg,set()))
    elif func=="sum":
        if state.counts.get(arg,0)==0:
            return None
        return state.sums[arg]
    elif func=="min":
        if state.counts.get(arg,0)==0:
            return None
        return state.mins[arg]
    elif func=="max":
        if state.counts.get(arg,0)==0:
            return None
        return state.maxs[arg]
    elif func=="avg":
        cnt = state.counts.get(arg,0)
        if cnt==0:
            return None
        return state.sums[arg] // cnt
    else:
        raise
